# Tunnels: References

Always prefer current vendor documentation. These tools change quickly; re-verify links, flags, and
defaults when updating this skill.

Last verified: 2026-10-30

## Vendor (authoritative)

**ngrok**

- Agent configuration file (locations, `ngrok config check`, `NGROK_AUTHTOKEN`, `NGROK_API_KEY`):
  https://ngrok.com/docs/agent/config/
- Agent CLI reference (deprecated `--oauth`, `--basic-auth`, `--cidr-allow` for HTTP;
  `--traffic-policy-file`; `ngrok service`): https://ngrok.com/docs/agent/cli/
- Web inspection interface (default `localhost:4040`, records request and response bodies):
  https://ngrok.com/docs/agent/web-inspection-interface/
- Traffic Policy (authentication, IP restrictions, rate limiting, JWT validation):
  https://ngrok.com/docs/traffic-policy/
- Free plan limits (assigned dev domain, interstitial page):
  https://ngrok.com/docs/pricing-limits/free-plan-limits/
- Changelog and agent releases: https://ngrok.com/docs/agent/changelog/

**Tailscale and Headscale**

- Funnel (public; ports 443, 8443, 10000; `funnel` node attribute): https://tailscale.com/kb/1223/funnel
- Serve (tailnet-only; `tailscale serve status`, `reset`, `--bg`): https://tailscale.com/kb/1242/tailscale-serve
- HTTPS certificates (names published in certificate transparency logs):
  https://tailscale.com/kb/1153/enabling-https
- Key expiry (180-day default; tagged devices): https://tailscale.com/kb/1028/key-expiry
- Subnet routers (route approval, `autoApprovers`, SNAT): https://tailscale.com/kb/1019/subnets
- Exit nodes (admin approval, LAN access, `autogroup:internet`): https://tailscale.com/kb/1103/exit-nodes
- Security bulletins: https://tailscale.com/security-bulletins
- Changelog: https://tailscale.com/changelog
- Headscale project and releases: https://github.com/juanfont/headscale

- Project documentation (auth methods, TLS defaults since v0.50.0, dashboard, `allowPorts`, `stcp`/`xtcp`):

- Releases: https://github.com/fatedier/frp/releases
- Security advisories: https://github.com/fatedier/frp/security/advisories

## Third-party (not authoritative)

- Sophos, "Rapid Response: The ngrok incident guide":
  https://www.sophos.com/en-us/blog/rapid-response-the-ngrok-incident-guide (practical responder notes on
  ngrok abuse; vendor marketing context, verify specifics).
- Certificate transparency search (for example https://crt.sh/): shows `ts.net` and custom-domain names
  that have had certificates issued, which is how others find "hidden" published names. Includes
  historical names and doesn't prove a name is live.
